content.short: Superform is a universal yield marketplace that enables one-click access to any vault on any supported chain.
content.description:
Superform is a pioneering decentralized yield marketplace and cross-chain router designed to simplify the multi-chain investment experience. The platform allows users to discover and access over 800 earning opportunities from top-tier protocols—such as Aave, Morpho, and Pendle—using any token on any supported chain in a single, unified transaction. By utilizing its proprietary "SuperPositions" (ERC-1155 tokens), Superform enables participants to manage their diversified yield positions across the entire Web3 ecosystem from a single "home" network.

Operating as an intent-based architecture, the protocol optimizes liquidity routing to ensure the best possible execution and capital efficiency for users. The platform focuses on professional-grade transparency and security, serving as a vital infrastructure layer for both retail and institutional yield seekers. Through its commitment to chain abstraction and user-centric design, Superform is building the essential framework for a more accessible and interconnected decentralized economy, where yields are as intuitive to manage as any traditional financial instrument.
